entities.summary: Enzo Dieci is an Italian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church, who left Rome in December 2009 and currently serves 35 km from Lima in the Church of the Sagrado Corazon de Jesus. Born in Sassuolo, Dieci was ordained to the priesthood on 17 March 1962.
